Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Workspace Indicators (All Compositors)

Workspaces are the heart of a tiling-WM bar. This project builds a polished indicator with a sliding pill, occupied/empty/urgent states, scroll-to-switch, and optional app icons. We first build it for Hyprland, then make a compositor-neutral service so the same UI works on Sway and niri.

Design#

  • Always show workspaces 1–10 (configurable), even when they don't exist yet.
  • Active workspace: a wide pill in primary that slides between positions.
  • Occupied: a solid dot. Empty: a faint dot. Urgent: an error-colored dot that pulses.
  • Scroll on the widget to move between workspaces; click to jump.

A compositor-neutral service#

services/Workspaces.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.I3
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property string backend: Quickshell.env("HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE") ? "hyprland"
                                    : Quickshell.env("SWAYSOCK") ? "sway"
                                    : Quickshell.env("NIRI_SOCKET") ? "niri" : "none"

    // id of the active workspace on a given screen
    function activeOn(screen: ShellScreen): int {
        if (backend === "hyprland") return Hyprland.monitorFor(screen)?.activeWorkspace?.id ?? 1
        if (backend === "sway") return I3.monitorFor(screen)?.activeWorkspace?.number ?? 1
        return 1
    }
    // true if workspace `id` has windows
    function occupied(id: int): bool {
        if (backend === "hyprland")
            return Hyprland.workspaces.values.some(w => w.id === id && w.toplevels.values.length > 0)
        if (backend === "sway")
            return I3.workspaces.values.some(w => w.number === id)       // sway only lists non-empty workspaces
        return false
    }
    function urgent(id: int): bool {
        if (backend === "hyprland") return Hyprland.workspaces.values.some(w => w.id === id && w.urgent)
        if (backend === "sway") return I3.workspaces.values.some(w => w.number === id && w.urgent)
        return false
    }
    function focus(id: int): void {
        if (backend === "hyprland") Hyprland.dispatch(Hyprland.usingLua ? `hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = "${id}" })` : `workspace ${id}`)
        else if (backend === "sway") I3.dispatch(`workspace number ${id}`)
        else if (backend === "niri") Quickshell.execDetached(["niri", "msg", "action", "focus-workspace", String(id)])
    }
    function relative(delta: int, screen: ShellScreen): void {
        const next = Math.max(1, Math.min(Config.bar.workspaceCount ?? 10, activeOn(screen) + delta))
        focus(next)
    }
}
Bindings through functions

Workspaces.activeOn(screen) used in a binding still updates: QML tracks the properties the function reads (activeWorkspace.id, workspaces.values…).

The widget#

modules/bar/Workspaces.qmlimport Quickshell
import QtQuick
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Rectangle {
    id: root
    required property ShellScreen screen
    readonly property int count: Config.bar.workspaceCount ?? 10
    readonly property int active: Workspaces.activeOn(screen)
    readonly property int dot: 8
    readonly property int pillWidth: 26
    readonly property int gap: 6

    implicitWidth: row.implicitWidth + 16
    implicitHeight: 28
    radius: height / 2
    color: Colors.surfaceContainerHigh

    // the sliding active pill (behind the dots)
    Rectangle {
        readonly property Item target: rep.itemAt(root.active - 1)
        x: row.x + (target?.x ?? 0)
        width: target?.width ?? 0
        height: root.dot + 4
        radius: height / 2
        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
        color: Colors.primary
        Behavior on x { NumberAnimation { duration: 300; easing.type: Easing.OutBack; easing.overshoot: 1.1 } }
        Behavior on width { Anim {} }
    }

    Row {
        id: row
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        spacing: root.gap

        Repeater {
            id: rep
            model: root.count
            Item {
                id: cell
                required property int index
                readonly property int wsId: index + 1
                readonly property bool isActive: wsId === root.active
                readonly property bool isOccupied: Workspaces.occupied(wsId)
                readonly property bool isUrgent: Workspaces.urgent(wsId)

                width: isActive ? root.pillWidth : root.dot + 4
                height: root.dot + 4
                Behavior on width { Anim {} }

                Rectangle {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    visible: !cell.isActive
                    width: root.dot; height: root.dot; radius: root.dot / 2
                    color: cell.isUrgent ? Colors.error
                         : cell.isOccupied ? Colors.onSurfaceVariant
                         : Colors.alpha(Colors.onSurfaceVariant, 0.3)
                    Behavior on color { CAnim {} }

                    SequentialAnimation on opacity {           // urgent pulse
                        running: cell.isUrgent
                        loops: Animation.Infinite
                        NumberAnimation { to: 0.3; duration: 500 }
                        NumberAnimation { to: 1.0; duration: 500 }
                        onStopped: parent.opacity = 1
                    }
                }

                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    anchors.margins: -3                      // bigger click target
                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                    onClicked: Workspaces.focus(cell.wsId)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    WheelHandler {
        acceptedDevices: PointerDevice.Mouse | PointerDevice.TouchPad
        property real acc: 0
        onWheel: e => {
            acc += e.angleDelta.y
            if (Math.abs(acc) >= 120) {
                Workspaces.relative(acc > 0 ? -1 : 1, root.screen)
                acc = 0
            }
        }
    }
}

Variant: numbered workspaces#

Replace the dot with a StyledText { text: cell.wsId }, colored Colors.onPrimary when active and Colors.onSurfaceVariant otherwise. Make the pill a fixed 24 px circle.

Variant: app icons per workspace (Hyprland)#

Row {
    spacing: 2
    Repeater {
        model: Hyprland.workspaces.values.find(w => w.id === cell.wsId)?.toplevels ?? []
        IconImage {
            required property HyprlandToplevel modelData
            implicitSize: 14
            source: Quickshell.iconPath(
                DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(modelData.lastIpcObject?.class ?? modelData.wayland?.appId ?? "")?.icon ?? "",
                "application-x-executable")
        }
    }
}

lastIpcObject may be empty until refreshed; listen to openwindow/closewindow raw events and call Hyprland.refreshToplevels().

Variant: niri with the fork module#

// in Workspaces service
if (backend === "niri") return Niri.workspaces.values.find(w => w.focused && w.output === screen.name)?.idx ?? 1

import Quickshell.Niri requires the noctalia-qs build (Talking to Your Compositor).

Special workspaces (Hyprland scratchpads)#

Special workspaces have negative ids and names like special:magic. Show an indicator when one is open on this monitor:

MaterialIcon {
    readonly property var mon: Hyprland.monitorFor(root.screen)
    visible: (mon?.lastIpcObject?.specialWorkspace?.name ?? "") !== ""
    icon: "visibility"
}

(lastIpcObject for monitors needs Hyprland.refreshMonitors() on the activespecial event.)

Exercises
  1. Make the workspace count configurable from config.json.
  2. Add a tooltip showing the window titles on hover.
  3. Hide empty workspaces above the highest occupied one (dynamic count).

Project: Clock and Calendar Popup

A clock in the center of the bar; click it and a Material-style calendar drops down with month navigation, today highlighted, week numbers and an optional events list.

Time service#

One shared clock for the whole shell:

services/Time.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root
    property bool showSeconds: Config.bar.showSeconds ?? false
    property bool use24h: Config.bar.use24h ?? true

    SystemClock {
        id: clock
        precision: root.showSeconds ? SystemClock.Seconds : SystemClock.Minutes
    }
    readonly property date now: clock.date
    readonly property string time: Qt.formatDateTime(clock.date,
        (use24h ? "hh:mm" : "h:mm") + (showSeconds ? ":ss" : "") + (use24h ? "" : " AP"))
    readonly property string date: Qt.formatDateTime(clock.date, "ddd d MMM")
    readonly property string greeting: clock.hours < 12 ? "Good morning"
                                     : clock.hours < 18 ? "Good afternoon" : "Good evening"
}

The clock button#

modules/bar/Clock.qmlimport Quickshell

The calendar grid#

modules/bar/CalendarGrid.qmlimport QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

ColumnLayout {
    id: root
    property date today
    property int offset: 0                         // months away from today
    property bool mondayFirst: true

    readonly property date shown: new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() + offset, 1)
    readonly property int firstWeekday: mondayFirst ? (shown.getDay() + 6) % 7 : shown.getDay()
    readonly property int daysInMonth: new Date(shown.getFullYear(), shown.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate()
    readonly property int daysInPrev: new Date(shown.getFullYear(), shown.getMonth(), 0).getDate()
    spacing: 6

    function isoWeek(d) {                           // ISO-8601 week number
        const t = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate()))
        const day = t.getUTCDay() || 7
        t.setUTCDate(t.getUTCDate() + 4 - day)
        const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(t.getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1))
        return Math.ceil(((t - yearStart) / 86400000 + 1) / 7)
    }

    // header: < Month Year >
    RowLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        IconButton { icon: "chevron_left"; size: 28; onClicked: root.offset-- }
        StyledText {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
            text: Qt.formatDate(root.shown, "MMMM yyyy")
            font.bold: true
            TapHandler { onTapped: root.offset = 0 }        // click the title → back to today
        }
        IconButton { icon: "chevron_right"; size: 28; onClicked: root.offset++ }
    }

    GridLayout {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        columns: 8
        columnSpacing: 2; rowSpacing: 2

        // weekday header (first column = week number)
        StyledText { text: "Wk"; color: Colors.outline; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.tiny; Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter }
        Repeater {
            model: root.mondayFirst ? ["Mo","Tu","We","Th","Fr","Sa","Su"] : ["Su","Mo","Tu","We","Th","Fr","Sa"]
            StyledText {
                required property string modelData
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                text: modelData
                color: Colors.outline
                font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
            }
        }

        // 6 rows × (week number + 7 days)
        Repeater {
            model: 6 * 8
            Rectangle {
                id: cell
                required property int index
                readonly property int row: Math.floor(index / 8)
                readonly property int col: index % 8
                readonly property int dayIndex: row * 7 + (col - 1)
                readonly property int day: dayIndex - root.firstWeekday + 1
                readonly property bool inMonth: day >= 1 && day <= root.daysInMonth
                readonly property date cellDate: new Date(root.shown.getFullYear(), root.shown.getMonth(), day)
                readonly property bool isToday: inMonth && cellDate.toDateString() === root.today.toDateString()

                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredHeight: 32
                radius: 16
                color: isToday ? Colors.primary : hov.hovered && col > 0 ? Colors.surfaceContainerHighest : "transparent"
                HoverHandler { id: hov }

                StyledText {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    text: cell.col === 0 ? root.isoWeek(new Date(root.shown.getFullYear(), root.shown.getMonth(), cell.row * 7 - root.firstWeekday + 4))
                        : cell.inMonth ? cell.day
                        : cell.day < 1 ? root.daysInPrev + cell.day : cell.day - root.daysInMonth
                    color: cell.isToday ? Colors.onPrimary
                         : cell.col === 0 ? Colors.outline
                         : cell.inMonth ? Colors.onSurface : Colors.alpha(Colors.onSurface, 0.3)
                    font.pixelSize: cell.col === 0 ? Appearance.font.size.tiny : Appearance.font.size.normal
                    font.bold: cell.isToday
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // scroll to change month
    WheelHandler { onWheel: e => root.offset += e.angleDelta.y > 0 ? -1 : 1 }
}

Optional: events from khal#

Process {
    id: events
    command: ["khal", "list", "today", "7d", "--format", "{start-time} {title}"]
    running: popup.visible
    stdout: StdioCollector { onStreamFinished: eventText.text = text.trim() || "No events" }
}
StyledText { id: eventText; wrapMode: Text.Wrap; Layout.fillWidth: true; color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant }

Optional: world clocks#

Repeater {
    model: [{ name: "Tokyo", tz: 9 }, { name: "London", tz: 0 }, { name: "New York", tz: -5 }]
    StyledText {
        required property var modelData
        readonly property date t: new Date(Time.now.getTime() + (modelData.tz * 60 + Time.now.getTimezoneOffset()) * 60000)
        text: modelData.name + "  " + Qt.formatTime(t, "hh:mm")
    }
}

(Fixed offsets ignore daylight saving; use TZ=… date through Process for exact zones.)

Project: System Tray with Custom Menus

Apps like Discord, Steam, nm-applet and Telegram put icons in the tray. This project shows them, handles left/middle/right clicks and scrolling, fixes broken icon paths, and draws fully custom-styled menus with submenus, checkboxes and separators.

The tray row#

modules/bar/Tray.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Services.SystemTray
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Rectangle {
    id: root
    required property var bar
    property bool expanded: true

    visible: SystemTray.items.values.length > 0
    implicitWidth: row.implicitWidth + 12
    implicitHeight: 28
    radius: height / 2
    color: Colors.surfaceContainerHigh
    clip: true
    Behavior on implicitWidth { Anim {} }

    Row {
        id: row
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        spacing: 6

        Repeater {
            model: ScriptModel {
                // hide passive items unless expanded; keep a stable order
                values: SystemTray.items.values.filter(i => root.expanded || i.status !== Status.Passive)
            }

            TrayIcon { bar: root.bar }
        }
    }
}

One tray icon#

modules/bar/TrayIcon.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Services.SystemTray
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Item {
    id: root
    required property SystemTrayItem modelData
    required property var bar
    implicitWidth: 20; implicitHeight: 20

    // Some apps send "name?path=/dir" icons. Rewrite them to a file URL.
    readonly property string iconSource: {
        const ic = modelData.icon
        if (ic.includes("?path=")) {
            const [name, path] = ic.split("?path=")
            const file = name.substring(name.lastIndexOf("/") + 1)
            return `file://${path}/${file}`
        }
        return ic
    }

    IconImage {
        id: img
        anchors.fill: parent
        source: root.iconSource
        asynchronous: true
        opacity: root.modelData.status === Status.NeedsAttention ? (blink.on ? 1 : 0.4) : 1
        scale: hover.hovered ? 1.12 : 1
        Behavior on scale { Anim { duration: Appearance.anim.fast } }
    }
    Timer { id: blink; property bool on: true; interval: 600; repeat: true
            running: root.modelData.status === Status.NeedsAttention; onTriggered: on = !on }

    HoverHandler { id: hover; cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor }

    MouseArea {
        anchors.fill: parent
        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.RightButton | Qt.MiddleButton
        onClicked: m => {
            if (m.button === Qt.LeftButton && !root.modelData.onlyMenu) root.modelData.activate()
            else if (m.button === Qt.MiddleButton) root.modelData.secondaryActivate()
            else if (root.modelData.hasMenu) menu.open()
        }
        onWheel: w => root.modelData.scroll(w.angleDelta.y / 120, false)
    }

    Tooltip {
        target: root
        text: root.modelData.tooltipTitle || root.modelData.title
        show: hover.hovered && !menu.visible
    }

    TrayMenu {
        id: menu
        anchorItem: root
        menuHandle: root.modelData.menu
    }
}

Tooltip is the widget from Popups, Anchors and Menus (move it to widgets/).

Option A: native-looking menu (one line)#

If you don't care about styling:

QsMenuAnchor {
    id: menu
    menu: root.modelData.menu
    anchor.item: root
    anchor.edges: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.gravity: Edges.Bottom
}
// menu.open()

Option B: a fully custom menu#

QsMenuOpener exposes a menu's entries as QsMenuEntry objects, so you can draw them yourself. Submenus are handled by pushing another opener onto a stack.

modules/bar/TrayMenu.qmlimport Quickshell
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

PopupWindow {
    id: root
    required property Item anchorItem
    property var menuHandle                        // QsMenuHandle from the tray item
    property var stack: []                         // submenu path (list of QsMenuEntry)
    readonly property var currentMenu: stack.length ? stack[stack.length - 1] : menuHandle

    function open(): void { stack = []; visible = true }
    function close(): void { visible = false }

    anchor.item: anchorItem
    anchor.edges: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.gravity: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.margins.top: 10
    anchor.adjustment: PopupAdjustment.Slide | PopupAdjustment.Flip
    implicitWidth: 240
    implicitHeight: list.implicitHeight + 12
    color: "transparent"
    visible: false
    grabFocus: true

    QsMenuOpener { id: opener; menu: root.currentMenu }

    StyledRect {
        anchors.fill: parent
        level: 2
        radius: Appearance.rounding.normal

        ColumnLayout {
            id: list
            anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 6 }
            spacing: 2

            // back button inside submenus
            MenuRow {
                visible: root.stack.length > 0
                label: "Back"
                leadingIcon: "arrow_back"
                onActivated: root.stack = root.stack.slice(0, -1)
            }

            Repeater {
                model: opener.children
                MenuRow {
                    required property QsMenuEntry modelData
                    entry: modelData
                    onActivated: {
                        if (modelData.hasChildren) root.stack = [...root.stack, modelData]
                        else { modelData.triggered(); root.close() }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
modules/bar/MenuRow.qmlimport Quickshell
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import Quickshell.Widgets
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Item {
    id: root
    property QsMenuEntry entry: null
    property string label: entry?.text ?? ""
    property string leadingIcon: ""
    signal activated()

    readonly property bool separator: entry?.isSeparator ?? false
    readonly property bool enabledEntry: entry ? entry.enabled : true

    Layout.fillWidth: true
    implicitHeight: separator ? 9 : 32

    Rectangle {                                    // separator line
        visible: root.separator
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        width: parent.width - 12; height: 1
        color: Colors.outlineVariant
    }

    Rectangle {
        visible: !root.separator
        anchors.fill: parent
        radius: Appearance.rounding.small
        color: hov.hovered && root.enabledEntry ? Colors.surfaceContainerHighest : "transparent"

        RowLayout {
            anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 10; rightMargin: 10 }
            spacing: 8

            // checkbox / radio indicator
            MaterialIcon {
                visible: (root.entry?.buttonType ?? QsMenuButtonType.None) !== QsMenuButtonType.None
                icon: root.entry?.buttonType === QsMenuButtonType.RadioButton
                      ? (root.entry?.checkState === Qt.Checked ? "radio_button_checked" : "radio_button_unchecked")
                      : (root.entry?.checkState === Qt.Checked ? "check_box" : "check_box_outline_blank")
                size: 18
                color: Colors.primary
            }
            MaterialIcon { visible: root.leadingIcon !== ""; icon: root.leadingIcon; size: 18 }
            IconImage {
                visible: (root.entry?.icon ?? "") !== ""
                source: root.entry?.icon ?? ""
                implicitSize: 16
            }
            StyledText {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                text: root.label.replace(/_/g, "")       // strip mnemonic underscores like "_Quit"
                color: root.enabledEntry ? Colors.onSurface : Colors.alpha(Colors.onSurface, 0.38)
            }
            MaterialIcon { visible: root.entry?.hasChildren ?? false; icon: "chevron_right"; size: 18 }
        }
        HoverHandler { id: hov }
        TapHandler { enabled: root.enabledEntry; onTapped: root.activated() }
    }
}

How it works#

  • QsMenuOpener.menu accepts the tray item's menu or any QsMenuEntry with children, which is how submenus work.
  • opener.children is an ObjectModel of entries; it updates when the app changes its menu.
  • entry.triggered() sends the click to the application.
  • checkState uses Qt's Qt.Unchecked / Qt.PartiallyChecked / Qt.Checked.
  • Some apps build menus lazily. If a menu is empty the first time, the underlying DBusMenuItem.updateLayout() can refresh it.
In the wild

Both end-4 and Caelestia render tray menus themselves with QsMenuOpener so they match the theme. Caelestia animates submenus sliding horizontally.

Exercises

Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Notification Daemon

Replace dunst/mako/swaync with your own notification system: popups that slide in, auto-expire with a progress bar, pause on hover, show images and action buttons, respect Do Not Disturb, and a history kept for the control center.

Only one daemon

The notification bus name can be owned by one program at a time. Stop the old daemon (pkill dunst mako swaync) and remove it from autostart, or Quickshell's server will fail to register.

The service#

services/Notifs.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Services.Notifications
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property var list: server.trackedNotifications.values      // all (history)
    readonly property int count: list.length
    property var popups: []                                             // currently shown as popups

    function init(): void {}                       // called from shell.qml so the server starts at login

    NotificationServer {
        id: server
        keepOnReload: true
        persistenceSupported: true
        bodySupported: true
        bodyMarkupSupported: true
        bodyHyperlinksSupported: true
        bodyImagesSupported: false
        actionsSupported: true
        actionIconsSupported: true
        imageSupported: true
        inlineReplySupported: true

        onNotification: n => {
            n.tracked = true                       // keep it (otherwise it's dropped immediately)
            n.closed.connect(() => root.hidePopup(n))   // remove its popup when it closes
            if (n.lastGeneration) return           // re-emitted after a hot reload: don't re-popup
            const critical = n.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Critical
            if (!GlobalStates.dnd || critical)
                root.popups = [n, ...root.popups].slice(0, 6)            // newest first, max 6
        }
    }

    function hidePopup(n): void { popups = popups.filter(p => p !== n) }
    function dismiss(n): void { hidePopup(n); n.dismiss() }
    function clearAll(): void { [...list].forEach(n => n.dismiss()); popups = [] }
}

n.tracked = true means "keep this notification in trackedNotifications". It stays there until dismiss(), expire() or the app closes it, which makes trackedNotifications a ready-made history.

The popup window#

modules/notifications/NotificationPopups.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import QtQuick
import qs.services

PanelWindow {
    id: win
    screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === GlobalStates.activeScreen) ?? null
    anchors { top: !Config.bar.bottom; bottom: Config.bar.bottom; right: true }
    margins { top: 8; bottom: 8; right: 8 }
    implicitWidth: Appearance.sizes.notificationWidth + 20    // room for shadows
    implicitHeight: Math.max(1, list.contentHeight + 20)
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Normal
    color: "transparent"
    visible: Notifs.popups.length > 0 && !GlobalStates.controlCenterOpen
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:notifications"
    mask: Region { item: list.contentItem }                   // only cards catch clicks

    ListView {
        id: list
        anchors { fill: parent; margins: 10 }
        spacing: 8
        interactive: false
        model: ScriptModel { values: Notifs.popups }
        delegate: NotificationCard {
            required property var modelData
            notif: modelData
            width: ListView.view.width
            popup: true
            onTimeout: Notifs.hidePopup(modelData)
        }
        add: Transition {
            ParallelAnimation {
                NumberAnimation { property: "x"; from: 420; to: 0; duration: 400; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
                NumberAnimation { property: "opacity"; from: 0; to: 1; duration: 250 }
            }
        }
        remove: Transition {
            ParallelAnimation {
                NumberAnimation { property: "x"; to: 420; duration: 250; easing.type: Easing.InCubic }
                NumberAnimation { property: "opacity"; to: 0; duration: 200 }
            }
        }
        displaced: Transition { NumberAnimation { property: "y"; duration: 300; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
    }
}

The notification card#

Used both for popups and in the control-center history:

modules/notifications/NotificationCard.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets
import Quickshell.Services.Notifications
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

StyledRect {
    id: root
    required property Notification notif
    property bool popup: false
    property bool expanded: false
    signal timeout()

    readonly property bool critical: notif?.urgency === NotificationUrgency.Critical
    // expireTimeout is in SECONDS; <= 0 means "server decides"
    readonly property int timeoutMs: critical ? 0 : (notif?.expireTimeout > 0 ? notif.expireTimeout * 1000 : 5000)

    level: popup ? 2 : 0
    implicitHeight: content.implicitHeight + 24
    radius: Appearance.rounding.large
    color: critical ? Colors.alpha(Colors.error, 0.15) : (popup ? Colors.surfaceContainer : Colors.surfaceContainerHigh)
    border.width: critical ? 1 : 0
    border.color: Colors.error
    Behavior on implicitHeight { Anim {} }

    HoverHandler { id: hover }

    // countdown, paused on hover
    property real elapsed: 0
    Timer {
        running: root.popup && root.timeoutMs > 0 && !hover.hovered
        interval: 50; repeat: true
        onTriggered: { root.elapsed += interval; if (root.elapsed >= root.timeoutMs) root.timeout() }
    }

    // swipe right to dismiss
    DragHandler {
        id: drag
        xAxis.enabled: true; yAxis.enabled: false
        xAxis.minimum: 0
        onActiveChanged: if (!active) { if (root.x > 120) Notifs.dismiss(root.notif); else root.x = 0 }
    }
    opacity: 1 - Math.min(1, x / 300)

    ColumnLayout {
        id: content
        anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 12 }
        spacing: 8

        RowLayout {
            spacing: 10
            Layout.fillWidth: true

            // image (avatar / album art) or app icon
            ClippingRectangle {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 42; Layout.preferredHeight: 42
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignTop
                radius: root.notif?.image ? 21 : Appearance.rounding.normal
                color: Colors.secondaryContainer
                Image {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    visible: !!root.notif?.image
                    source: root.notif?.image ?? ""
                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                    sourceSize: Qt.size(84, 84)
                    asynchronous: true
                }
                IconImage {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    visible: !root.notif?.image
                    implicitSize: 26
                    source: Quickshell.iconPath(root.notif?.appIcon || root.notif?.desktopEntry || "", "dialog-information")
                }
            }

            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                spacing: 2
                RowLayout {
                    StyledText {
                        text: root.notif?.appName ?? ""
                        color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant
                        font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                    }
                    IconButton {
                        visible: (root.notif?.body ?? "").length > 120
                        icon: root.expanded ? "expand_less" : "expand_more"
                        size: 24
                        onClicked: root.expanded = !root.expanded
                    }
                    IconButton { icon: "close"; size: 24; onClicked: Notifs.dismiss(root.notif) }
                }
                StyledText {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.notif?.summary ?? ""
                    font.bold: true
                    font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.large
                }
                StyledText {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    visible: text.length > 0
                    text: root.notif?.body ?? ""
                    textFormat: Text.StyledText                    // <b>, <i>, <a href>
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    elide: Text.ElideRight
                    maximumLineCount: root.expanded ? 20 : 3
                    color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant
                    onLinkActivated: link => Qt.openUrlExternally(link)
                }
            }
        }

        // inline reply (chat apps)
        TextField {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            visible: root.notif?.hasInlineReply ?? false
            placeholderText: root.notif?.inlineReplyPlaceholder || "Reply…"
            onAccepted: { root.notif.sendInlineReply(text); text = "" }
        }

        // action buttons
        RowLayout {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            visible: (root.notif?.actions.length ?? 0) > 0
            spacing: 6
            Repeater {
                model: (root.notif?.actions ?? []).filter(a => a.identifier !== "default")
                Rectangle {
                    required property NotificationAction modelData
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    implicitHeight: 32
                    radius: 16
                    color: Colors.secondaryContainer
                    StyledText {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        text: modelData.text
                        color: Colors.onSecondaryContainer
                    }
                    StateLayer { tint: Colors.onSecondaryContainer; onClicked: modelData.invoke() }
                }
            }
        }

        // timeout progress bar
        Rectangle {
            visible: root.popup && root.timeoutMs > 0
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            implicitHeight: 3
            radius: 2
            color: Colors.surfaceContainerHighest
            Rectangle {
                width: parent.width * Math.max(0, 1 - root.elapsed / Math.max(1, root.timeoutMs))
                height: parent.height; radius: 2
                color: Colors.primary
            }
        }
    }

    // clicking the body runs the "default" action
    TapHandler {
        onTapped: {
            const d = root.notif?.actions.find(a => a.identifier === "default")
            if (d) d.invoke()
        }
    }
}

Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: App Launcher

A keyboard-driven launcher that replaces rofi: fuzzy search over installed apps, sorted by how often you use them, with extra modes (= calculator, > run command, : emoji, ? web search), desktop-action support (e.g. "New Private Window"), and smooth animations.

Fuzzy matching#

A small scorer that rewards prefix matches, word-start matches and consecutive characters:

utils/fuzzy.js.pragma library

// returns -1 for no match, higher = better
function score(text, query) {
    if (!query) return 1
    text = text.toLowerCase(); query = query.toLowerCase()
    if (text === query) return 1000
    if (text.startsWith(query)) return 800 - text.length
    const idx = text.indexOf(query)
    if (idx >= 0) return (text[idx - 1] === " " || text[idx - 1] === "-" ? 600 : 400) - idx
    // subsequence: every query char appears in order
    let ti = 0, s = 0, streak = 0
    for (const c of query) {
        const found = text.indexOf(c, ti)
        if (found < 0) return -1
        streak = found === ti ? streak + 1 : 0
        s += 10 + streak * 5 - (found - ti)
        ti = found + 1
    }
    return s
}

Usage-frequency service#

services/Apps.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick
import "../utils/fuzzy.js" as Fuzzy

Singleton {
    id: root

    readonly property var all: DesktopEntries.applications.values.filter(a => !a.noDisplay)

    function search(query: string): var {
        return all
            .map(a => {
                const s = Math.max(Fuzzy.score(a.name, query),
                                   Fuzzy.score(a.genericName ?? "", query) - 100,
                                   (a.keywords ?? []).some(k => Fuzzy.score(k, query) > 0) ? 150 : -1)
                return { app: a, score: s < 0 ? -1 : s + (counts.counts[a.id] ?? 0) * 20 }
            })
            .filter(x => x.score >= 0)
            .sort((x, y) => y.score - x.score || x.app.name.localeCompare(y.app.name))
            .slice(0, 60)
            .map(x => x.app)
    }

    function launch(entry: DesktopEntry): void {
        counts.counts = Object.assign({}, counts.counts, { [entry.id]: (counts.counts[entry.id] ?? 0) + 1 })
        if (entry.runInTerminal)
            Quickshell.execDetached([Config.terminal, "-e", ...entry.command])
        else
            Quickshell.execDetached(entry.command)          // detached: survives shell reloads
    }

    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.statePath("app-counts.json")
        onAdapterUpdated: writeAdapter()
        printErrors: false
        JsonAdapter { id: counts; property var counts: ({}) }
    }
}

entry.command is the parsed Exec line (field codes like %U removed), safer than splitting execString yourself. entry.execute() also works; execDetached makes the app independent of the shell.

The launcher window#

modules/launcher/Launcher.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    IpcHandler {
        target: "launcher"
        function toggle(): void { GlobalStates.toggle("launcher") }
        function open(query: string): void { GlobalStates.launcherQuery = query; GlobalStates.open("launcher") }
    }

    LazyLoader {
        active: GlobalStates.launcherOpen

        PanelWindow {
            id: win
            screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === GlobalStates.activeScreen) ?? null
            implicitWidth: 640
            implicitHeight: 500
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
            WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:launcher"

            HyprlandFocusGrab { windows: [win]; active: true; onCleared: GlobalStates.launcherOpen = false }

            readonly property string query: input.text
            readonly property string mode: query.startsWith("=") ? "calc"
                                         : query.startsWith(">") ? "run"
                                         : query.startsWith("?") ? "web"
                                         : "apps"
            readonly property var results: mode === "apps" ? Apps.search(query) : []

            function close(): void { GlobalStates.launcherOpen = false }
            function accept(): void {
                if (mode === "calc") Quickshell.execDetached(["wl-copy", calcResult.text])
                else if (mode === "run") Quickshell.execDetached(["sh", "-c", query.slice(1)])
                else if (mode === "web") Qt.openUrlExternally("https://duckduckgo.com/?q=" + encodeURIComponent(query.slice(1).trim()))
                else if (list.currentItem) Apps.launch(results[list.currentIndex])
                close()
            }

            StyledRect {
                id: card
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 10
                level: 3
                radius: Appearance.rounding.large
                color: Colors.surface

                // entrance animation
                scale: 0.94; opacity: 0
                Component.onCompleted: { scale = 1; opacity = 1 }
                Behavior on scale { Anim {} }
                Behavior on opacity { Anim { duration: Appearance.anim.fast } }

                ColumnLayout {
                    anchors { fill: parent; margins: 14 }
                    spacing: 10

                    // search field
                    Rectangle {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        implicitHeight: 50
                        radius: 25
                        color: Colors.surfaceContainerHigh
                        RowLayout {
                            anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 18; rightMargin: 18 }
                            spacing: 12
                            MaterialIcon {
                                icon: ({ calc: "calculate", run: "terminal", web: "travel_explore", apps: "search" })[win.mode]
                                color: Colors.primary
                                size: 22
                            }
                            TextInput {
                                id: input
                                Layout.fillWidth: true
                                focus: true
                                text: GlobalStates.launcherQuery
                                color: Colors.onSurface
                                font.family: Appearance.font.family
                                font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.large
                                selectionColor: Colors.primary
                                selectedTextColor: Colors.onPrimary
                                clip: true
                                StyledText {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    visible: !parent.text
                                    text: "Search apps   = math   > command   ? web"
                                    color: Colors.outline
                                    font: parent.font
                                }
                                onTextChanged: list.currentIndex = 0
                                Keys.onEscapePressed: win.close()
                                Keys.onReturnPressed: win.accept()
                                Keys.onEnterPressed: win.accept()
                                Keys.onDownPressed: list.incrementCurrentIndex()
                                Keys.onUpPressed: list.decrementCurrentIndex()
                                Keys.onTabPressed: list.incrementCurrentIndex()
                                Keys.onBacktabPressed: list.decrementCurrentIndex()
                                Component.onDestruction: GlobalStates.launcherQuery = ""
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    // calculator (needs libqalculate's `qalc`)
                    StyledText {
                        id: calcResult
                        visible: win.mode === "calc"
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.huge
                        font.bold: true
                        color: Colors.primary
                        Process {
                            command: ["qalc", "-t", win.query.slice(1)]
                            running: win.mode === "calc" && win.query.length > 1
                            stdout: StdioCollector { onStreamFinished: calcResult.text = text.trim() }
                        }
                    }

                    StyledText {
                        visible: win.mode === "run" || win.mode === "web"
                        text: win.mode === "run" ? "Run: " + win.query.slice(1) : "Search the web for: " + win.query.slice(1)
                        color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant
                    }

                    // app list
                    ListView {
                        id: list
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.fillHeight: true
                        visible: win.mode === "apps"
                        clip: true
                        spacing: 2
                        model: ScriptModel { values: win.results }
                        highlight: Rectangle { radius: Appearance.rounding.normal; color: Colors.secondaryContainer }
                        highlightMoveDuration: 120
                        boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds
                        delegate: AppItem {
                            required property DesktopEntry modelData
                            required property int index
                            entry: modelData
                            width: ListView.view.width
                            selected: ListView.isCurrentItem
                            onActivated: { list.currentIndex = index; win.accept() }
                            onHovered: list.currentIndex = index
                        }
                        StyledText {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            visible: list.count === 0
                            text: "No matching apps"
                            color: Colors.outline
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Project: Volume and Brightness OSD

An on-screen display that pops up when volume, mute, brightness or the microphone changes, from anywhere (media keys, pavucontrol, scripts), shows the level, and fades away after 1.5 seconds. It needs no special keybinds: it watches the system state.

Brightness service#

services/Brightness.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root
    property string device: ""                  // auto-detected below
    property int max: 1
    property int current: 0
    readonly property real value: max > 0 ? current / max : 0
    readonly property bool available: device !== ""

    function set(v: real): void {
        if (!available) return
        const pct = Math.round(Math.max(0.01, Math.min(1, v)) * 100)
        Quickshell.execDetached(["brightnessctl", "-d", device, "set", pct + "%"])
    }

    // find the first backlight device
    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", "ls /sys/class/backlight | head -1"]
        stdout: StdioCollector { onStreamFinished: root.device = text.trim() }
    }
    FileView {
        path: root.available ? `/sys/class/backlight/${root.device}/max_brightness` : ""
        onLoaded: root.max = parseInt(text())
    }
    FileView {
        path: root.available ? `/sys/class/backlight/${root.device}/brightness` : ""
        watchChanges: true
        onFileChanged: reload()
        onLoaded: root.current = parseInt(text())
    }
}
External monitors

For external monitors use ddcutil (ddcutil getvcp 10, ddcutil setvcp 10 70). It's slow (hundreds of ms), so debounce changes with a Timer and poll rarely.

The OSD#

modules/osd/Osd.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Services.Pipewire
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    id: root
    property string kind: "volume"          // volume | brightness | mic
    property bool shown: false
    property bool armed: false              // ignore the initial "changes" at startup

    function show(k: string): void {
        if (!armed || GlobalStates.locked) return
        kind = k
        shown = true
        hide.restart()
    }

    Timer { interval: 2000; running: true; onTriggered: root.armed = true }
    Timer { id: hide; interval: 1500; onTriggered: root.shown = false }

    Connections {
        target: Audio
        function onVolumeChanged() { root.show("volume") }
        function onMutedChanged() { root.show("volume") }
    }
    Connections {
        target: Pipewire.defaultAudioSource?.audio ?? null
        function onMutedChanged() { root.show("mic") }
    }
    Connections {
        target: Brightness
        function onCurrentChanged() { root.show("brightness") }
    }
    PwObjectTracker { objects: [Pipewire.defaultAudioSource] }

    readonly property real level: kind === "volume" ? (Audio.muted ? 0 : Audio.volume)
                                : kind === "brightness" ? Brightness.value
                                : (Pipewire.defaultAudioSource?.audio?.muted ? 0 : 1)
    readonly property string icon: kind === "brightness" ? (level > 0.5 ? "brightness_high" : "brightness_low")
                                 : kind === "mic" ? (level > 0 ? "mic" : "mic_off")
                                 : Audio.icon

    LazyLoader {
        active: root.shown || fadeOut.running

        PanelWindow {
            screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === GlobalStates.activeScreen) ?? null
            anchors.bottom: true
            margins.bottom: 90
            implicitWidth: 320
            implicitHeight: 64
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            mask: Region {}                                // purely visual, never blocks clicks
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:osd"

            StyledRect {
                id: pill
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 6
                level: 2
                radius: height / 2
                color: Colors.surfaceContainer

                opacity: root.shown ? 1 : 0
                y: root.shown ? 0 : 12
                Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { id: fadeOut; duration: 200 } }
                Behavior on y { Anim {} }

                RowLayout {
                    anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 18; rightMargin: 18 }
                    spacing: 14
                    MaterialIcon { icon: root.icon; fill: 1; size: 24; color: Colors.primary }
                    Rectangle {
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        implicitHeight: 8
                        radius: 4
                        color: Colors.surfaceContainerHighest
                        visible: root.kind !== "mic"
                        Rectangle {
                            width: parent.width * Math.min(1, root.level)
                            height: parent.height
                            radius: 4
                            color: root.level > 1 ? Colors.error : Colors.primary   // over-amplified volume
                            Behavior on width { Anim { duration: Appearance.anim.fast } }
                        }
                    }
                    StyledText {
                        Layout.fillWidth: root.kind === "mic"
                        text: root.kind === "mic" ? (root.level > 0 ? "Microphone on" : "Microphone muted")
                                                  : Math.round(root.level * 100)
                        font.bold: true
                        font.features: ({ "tnum": 1 })
                        horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignRight
                        Layout.preferredWidth: root.kind === "mic" ? -1 : 34
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Media keys#

The OSD reacts to state, so keybinds only change the state:

hyprland.confbindel = , XF86AudioRaiseVolume,  exec, wpctl set-volume -l 1.5 @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 5%+
bindel = , XF86AudioLowerVolume,  exec, wpctl set-volume @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ 5%-
bindl  = , XF86AudioMute,         exec, wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle
bindl  = , XF86AudioMicMute,      exec, wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ toggle
bindel = , XF86MonBrightnessUp,   exec, brightnessctl set 5%+
bindel = , XF86MonBrightnessDown, exec, brightnessctl set 5%-
bindl  = , XF86AudioPlay,         exec, playerctl play-pause
bindl  = , XF86AudioNext,         exec, playerctl next
bindl  = , XF86AudioPrev,         exec, playerctl previous

Variants#

  • Vertical OSD on the right edge: anchor right, swap the RowLayout for a ColumnLayout, and fill the track bottom-up.
  • Media OSD: show album art and title when the track changes (Connections { target: Media.active; function onTrackChanged() {…} }).
  • Caps Lock / keyboard layout OSD: Hyprland activelayout events.

Project: Media Player

A rich media popup: blurred album-art background, colors extracted from the art, title and artist, seekable progress with timestamps, play/pause with shape morph, shuffle/loop, player switcher, and an audio visualizer.

The popup#

modules/media/MediaPopup.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Widgets
import Quickshell.Services.Mpris
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import QtQuick.Effects
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

PopupWindow {
    id: root
    required property Item anchorItem
    readonly property MprisPlayer p: Media.active

    anchor.item: anchorItem
    anchor.edges: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.gravity: Edges.Bottom
    anchor.margins.top: 12
    implicitWidth: 420
    implicitHeight: 200
    color: "transparent"
    grabFocus: true
    visible: false

    function fmt(sec: real): string {
        const s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(sec))
        return Math.floor(s / 60) + ":" + String(s % 60).padStart(2, "0")
    }

    // accent from album art
    ColorQuantizer {
        id: palette
        source: root.p?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
        depth: 3
        rescaleSize: 64
    }
    readonly property color accent: palette.colors.length ? palette.colors[0] : Colors.primary
    readonly property color onAccent: (accent.hslLightness > 0.55) ? "#111111" : "#ffffff"

    ClippingRectangle {
        anchors.fill: parent
        radius: Appearance.rounding.large
        color: Colors.surface

        // blurred, darkened art behind everything

            id: bgArt
            anchors.fill: parent
            source: root.p?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
            fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
            sourceSize: Qt.size(256, 256)
            visible: false
        }
        MultiEffect {
            anchors.fill: bgArt
            source: bgArt
            blurEnabled: true; blur: 1; blurMax: 48
            brightness: -0.35; saturation: 0.2
            visible: bgArt.status === Image.Ready
        }

        RowLayout {
            anchors { fill: parent; margins: 16 }
            spacing: 16

            ClippingRectangle {
                Layout.preferredWidth: 140; Layout.preferredHeight: 140
                radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
                color: Colors.surfaceContainerHighest
                Image {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    source: root.p?.trackArtUrl ?? ""
                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                    sourceSize: Qt.size(280, 280)
                    asynchronous: true
                }
                MaterialIcon {
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    visible: !(root.p?.trackArtUrl)
                    icon: "music_note"; size: 48
                }
            }

            ColumnLayout {
                Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.fillHeight: true
                spacing: 4

                RowLayout {
                    StyledText { text: root.p?.identity ?? ""; color: "#ccffffff"; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small; Layout.fillWidth: true }
                    IconButton {                                 // switch player
                        visible: Media.players.length > 1
                        icon: "swap_horiz"; size: 26
                        onClicked: {
                            const i = Media.players.indexOf(root.p)
                            Media.manualPlayer = Media.players[(i + 1) % Media.players.length]
                        }
                    }
                }
                StyledText {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.p?.trackTitle || "Nothing playing"
                    color: "white"; font.bold: true; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.large
                }
                StyledText {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    text: root.p?.trackArtist || ""
                    color: "#ddffffff"
                }
                Item { Layout.fillHeight: true }

                // progress

                    id: seek
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    enabled: root.p?.canSeek ?? false
                    from: 0; to: Math.max(1, root.p?.length ?? 1)
                    value: root.p?.position ?? 0
                    onMoved: root.p.position = value
                }
                RowLayout {
                    StyledText { text: root.fmt(root.p?.position ?? 0); color: "#ccffffff"; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.tiny }
                    Item { Layout.fillWidth: true }

                }

                // controls
                RowLayout {
                    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                    spacing: 8
                    IconButton {
                        visible: root.p?.shuffleSupported ?? false
                        icon: "shuffle"; size: 30
                        toggled: root.p?.shuffle ?? false

                    }

                        color: root.accent

                        Behavior on color { CAnim {} }
                        MaterialIcon {

                    IconButton {

                        toggled: (root.p?.loopState ?? MprisLoopState.None) !== MprisLoopState.None
                        onClicked: root.p.loopState = root.p.loopState === MprisLoopState.None ? MprisLoopState.Playlist
                                                    : root.p.loopState === MprisLoopState.Playlist ? MprisLoopState.Track
                                                    : MprisLoopState.None
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Open it from the bar's media chip:

// in MediaChip.qml
MediaPopup { id: mediaPopup; anchorItem: root }
TapHandler { acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton; onTapped: mediaPopup.visible = !mediaPopup.visible }

A visualizer with cava#

cava can write raw bar heights to stdout. Configure it for ASCII output:

~/.config/quickshell/myshell/scripts/cava.conf[general]
bars = 24
framerate = 60
[output]
method = raw
raw_target = /dev/stdout
data_format = ascii
ascii_max_range = 100
bar_delimiter = 59
frame_delimiter = 10
modules/media/Visualizer.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick
import qs.services

Row {
    id: root
    property bool active: true
    property var bars: []
    spacing: 3
    height: 40

    Process {
        running: root.active && (Media.active?.isPlaying ?? false)
        command: ["cava", "-p", Quickshell.shellPath("scripts/cava.conf")]
        stdout: SplitParser {
            onRead: line => root.bars = line.split(";").filter(x => x !== "").map(Number)
        }
    }

    Repeater {
        model: root.bars.length
        Rectangle {
            required property int index
            width: 5
            height: Math.max(3, root.height * (root.bars[index] ?? 0) / 100)
            anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
            radius: 2.5
            color: Colors.primary
            Behavior on height { NumberAnimation { duration: 60 } }
        }
    }
}

The process only runs while something is playing and the visualizer is visible. For lighter CPU use, try PwNodePeakMonitor on the default sink for a single level meter, no external program needed:

PwNodePeakMonitor { id: peaks; node: Pipewire.defaultAudioSink; enabled: popup.visible }
Rectangle { width: 6; height: 40 * peaks.peak; color: Colors.primary }
In the wild

Caelestia ships a C++ plugin for its visualizer and beat detection so it costs almost no CPU; end-4 uses cava through a Process for its media controls.

  3. Animate the cover art (scale + fade) on trackChanged.

Project: Control Center

A sidebar that slides in from the right: header with avatar, uptime and power button; a grid of quick toggles (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, DND, caffeine, night light, power profile); volume, mic and brightness sliders with output-device picker; Wi-Fi and Bluetooth sub-pages; and the notification history.

Structure#

modules/controlcenter/
├── ControlCenter.qml     ← window + slide animation + page stack
├── Header.qml
├── QuickToggle.qml
├── SliderRow.qml
├── WifiPage.qml
├── BluetoothPage.qml
└── NotificationHistory.qml

The window#

modules/controlcenter/ControlCenter.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Bluetooth
import Quickshell.Services.UPower
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    Variants {
        model: Quickshell.screens

        PanelWindow {
            id: win
            required property ShellScreen modelData
            screen: modelData
            readonly property bool open: GlobalStates.controlCenterOpen && GlobalStates.activeScreen === modelData.name

            visible: open || slide.running
            anchors { top: true; bottom: true; right: true }
            margins { top: Appearance.sizes.barHeight + 16; bottom: 10; right: 8 }
            implicitWidth: 400
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Top
            WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: open ? WlrKeyboardFocus.OnDemand : WlrKeyboardFocus.None
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:controlcenter"

            HyprlandFocusGrab { windows: [win]; active: win.open; onCleared: GlobalStates.controlCenterOpen = false }

            StyledRect {
                id: panel
                width: parent.width
                height: parent.height
                level: 2
                color: Colors.surface
                radius: Appearance.rounding.large
                x: win.open ? 0 : width + 20
                Behavior on x { NumberAnimation { id: slide; duration: 380; easing.type: Easing.BezierSpline; easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.anim.emphasized } }

                Keys.onEscapePressed: GlobalStates.controlCenterOpen = false
                focus: win.open

                StackView {
                    id: pages
                    anchors { fill: parent; margins: 16 }
                    clip: true
                    initialItem: mainPage
                    // reset to the main page whenever the panel closes
                    Connections { target: win; function onOpenChanged() { if (!win.open) pages.pop(null) } }
                }

                Component {
                    id: mainPage
                    ColumnLayout {
                        spacing: 14

                        Header {}

                        GridLayout {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            columns: 2
                            rowSpacing: 8; columnSpacing: 8

                            QuickToggle {
                                icon: Network.icon
                                label: Network.wired ? "Ethernet" : (Network.ssid || "Wi-Fi")
                                active: Network.wifiEnabled && Network.online
                                hasDetails: true
                                onToggled: Network.toggleWifi()
                                onDetails: pages.push(wifiPage)
                            }
                            QuickToggle {
                                readonly property var bt: Bluetooth.defaultAdapter
                                icon: "bluetooth"
                                label: Bluetooth.devices.values.find(d => d.connected)?.name ?? "Bluetooth"
                                active: bt?.enabled ?? false
                                hasDetails: true
                                onToggled: if (bt) bt.enabled = !bt.enabled
                                onDetails: pages.push(btPage)
                            }
                            QuickToggle {
                                icon: GlobalStates.dnd ? "do_not_disturb_on" : "do_not_disturb_off"
                                label: "Do not disturb"
                                active: GlobalStates.dnd
                                onToggled: GlobalStates.dnd = !GlobalStates.dnd
                            }
                            QuickToggle {
                                icon: "coffee"
                                label: "Caffeine"
                                active: GlobalStates.caffeine
                                onToggled: GlobalStates.caffeine = !GlobalStates.caffeine
                            }
                            QuickToggle {
                                icon: "nightlight"
                                label: "Night light"
                                active: nightLight.running
                                onToggled: nightLight.running = !nightLight.running
                                Process { id: nightLight; command: ["hyprsunset", "-t", "4200"] }
                            }
                            QuickToggle {
                                icon: PowerProfiles.profile === PowerProfile.Performance ? "bolt"
                                    : PowerProfiles.profile === PowerProfile.PowerSaver ? "eco" : "balance"
                                label: PowerProfile.toString(PowerProfiles.profile)
                                active: PowerProfiles.profile !== PowerProfile.Balanced
                                onToggled: {
                                    const order = PowerProfiles.hasPerformanceProfile
                                        ? [PowerProfile.PowerSaver, PowerProfile.Balanced, PowerProfile.Performance]
                                        : [PowerProfile.PowerSaver, PowerProfile.Balanced]
                                    PowerProfiles.profile = order[(order.indexOf(PowerProfiles.profile) + 1) % order.length]
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        SliderRow {
                            icon: Audio.icon
                            value: Audio.muted ? 0 : Audio.volume
                            onMoved: v => Audio.setVolume(v)
                            onIconClicked: Audio.toggleMute()
                        }
                        SliderRow {
                            visible: Brightness.available
                            icon: "brightness_6"
                            value: Brightness.value
                            onMoved: v => Brightness.set(v)
                        }

                        NotificationHistory { Layout.fillWidth: true; Layout.fillHeight: true }
                    }
                }
                Component { id: wifiPage; WifiPage { onBack: pages.pop() } }
                Component { id: btPage; BluetoothPage { onBack: pages.pop() } }
            }
        }
    }
}

Header#

Quick toggle tile#

modules/controlcenter/QuickToggle.qmlimport QtQuick

    id: root
    property string icon

    property bool hasDetails: false

    signal details()

    implicitHeight: 60

    color: active ? Colors.primary : Colors.surfaceContainerHigh
    Behavior on color { CAnim {} }
    Behavior on radius { Anim {} }

        anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 16; rightMargin: 8 }

        StyledText {
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            text: root.label
            color: root.active ? Colors.onPrimary : Colors.onSurface
        }
        IconButton {
            visible: root.hasDetails
            icon: "chevron_right"; size: 28
            onClicked: root.details()
        }
    }
    StateLayer {
        z: -1
        tint: root.active ? Colors.onPrimary : Colors.onSurface
        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.RightButton
        onClicked: m => m.button === Qt.RightButton && root.hasDetails ? root.details() : root.toggled()
    }
}

Wi-Fi page (Networking module)#

modules/controlcenter/WifiPage.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Networking
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

ColumnLayout {
    id: root
    signal back()
    spacing: 10
    readonly property var dev: Network.wifiDevice
    property var pending: null                 // network waiting for a password

    Component.onCompleted: if (dev) dev.scannerEnabled = true
    Component.onDestruction: if (dev) dev.scannerEnabled = false

    RowLayout {
        IconButton { icon: "arrow_back"; onClicked: root.back() }
        StyledText { text: "Wi-Fi"; font.bold: true; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.title; Layout.fillWidth: true }
        StyledSwitch { checked: Networking.wifiEnabled; onToggled: Networking.wifiEnabled = checked }
    }

    ListView {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.fillHeight: true
        clip: true
        spacing: 4
        model: ScriptModel {
            values: (root.dev?.networks.values ?? []).slice().sort((a, b) => (b.connected - a.connected) || (b.signalStrength - a.signalStrength))
        }
        delegate: Rectangle {
            required property WifiNetwork modelData
            width: ListView.view.width
            implicitHeight: 52
            radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
            color: modelData.connected ? Colors.secondaryContainer : Colors.surfaceContainer

            RowLayout {
                anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 14; rightMargin: 10 }
                spacing: 10
                MaterialIcon {
                    icon: modelData.signalStrength > 0.66 ? "signal_wifi_4_bar"
                        : modelData.signalStrength > 0.33 ? "network_wifi_2_bar" : "network_wifi_1_bar"
                }
                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true; spacing: 0
                    StyledText { text: modelData.name; font.bold: modelData.connected; Layout.fillWidth: true }
                    StyledText {
                        text: modelData.stateChanging ? "Connecting…"
                            : modelData.connected ? "Connected"
                            : modelData.known ? "Saved" : WifiSecurityType.toString(modelData.security)
                        color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
                    }
                }
                MaterialIcon { visible: modelData.security !== WifiSecurityType.Open; icon: "lock"; size: 16 }
            }
            StateLayer {
                onClicked: {
                    if (modelData.connected) modelData.disconnect()
                    else if (modelData.known || modelData.security === WifiSecurityType.Open) modelData.connect()
                    else root.pending = modelData
                }
            }
            Connections {
                target: modelData
                function onConnectionFailed(reason) { root.pending = modelData; err.text = ConnectionFailReason.toString(reason) }
            }
        }
    }

    // password prompt
    ColumnLayout {
        visible: root.pending !== null
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        StyledText { text: "Password for " + (root.pending?.name ?? "") }
        StyledText { id: err; color: Colors.error; visible: text !== "" }
        TextField {
            id: psk
            Layout.fillWidth: true
            echoMode: TextInput.Password
            focus: visible
            onAccepted: { root.pending.connectWithPsk(text); text = ""; err.text = ""; root.pending = null }
            Keys.onEscapePressed: root.pending = null
        }
    }
}

Bluetooth page#

modules/controlcenter/BluetoothPage.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Bluetooth
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

ColumnLayout {
    id: root
    signal back()
    readonly property BluetoothAdapter adapter: Bluetooth.defaultAdapter
    spacing: 10

    Component.onCompleted: if (adapter?.enabled) adapter.discovering = true
    Component.onDestruction: if (adapter) adapter.discovering = false

    RowLayout {
        IconButton { icon: "arrow_back"; onClicked: root.back() }
        StyledText { text: "Bluetooth"; font.bold: true; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.title; Layout.fillWidth: true }
        MaterialIcon {                                       // scanning spinner
            visible: root.adapter?.discovering ?? false
            icon: "progress_activity"
            RotationAnimation on rotation { running: parent.visible; from: 0; to: 360; duration: 1000; loops: Animation.Infinite }
        }
        StyledSwitch { checked: root.adapter?.enabled ?? false; onToggled: root.adapter.enabled = checked }
    }

    ListView {
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.fillHeight: true
        clip: true
        spacing: 4
        model: ScriptModel {
            values: (root.adapter?.devices.values ?? []).slice().sort((a, b) => (b.connected - a.connected) || (b.paired - a.paired))
        }
        delegate: Rectangle {
            required property BluetoothDevice modelData
            width: ListView.view.width
            implicitHeight: 52
            radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
            color: modelData.connected ? Colors.secondaryContainer : Colors.surfaceContainer
            RowLayout {
                anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 14; rightMargin: 10 }
                spacing: 10
                IconImage { implicitSize: 22; source: Quickshell.iconPath(modelData.icon, "bluetooth") }
                ColumnLayout {
                    Layout.fillWidth: true; spacing: 0
                    StyledText { text: modelData.name || modelData.address; Layout.fillWidth: true }
                    StyledText {
                        text: modelData.pairing ? "Pairing…"
                            : modelData.state === BluetoothDeviceState.Connecting ? "Connecting…"
                            : modelData.connected ? "Connected" + (modelData.batteryAvailable ? " · " + Math.round(modelData.battery * 100) + "%" : "")
                            : modelData.paired ? "Paired" : "Available"
                        color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant; font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
                    }
                }
                IconButton { visible: modelData.paired; icon: "delete"; size: 28; onClicked: modelData.forget() }
            }
            StateLayer {
                onClicked: modelData.connected ? modelData.disconnect()
                         : modelData.paired ? modelData.connect()
                         : modelData.pair()
            }
        }
    }
}
