Project: Power Menu

A fullscreen session screen: dimmed (optionally blurred) background, big buttons for Lock, Logout, Suspend, Hibernate, Reboot and Shutdown, keyboard navigation, single-letter shortcuts, and a confirmation step for destructive actions.

modules/session/Session.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    IpcHandler { target: "session"; function toggle(): void { GlobalStates.toggle("session") } }

    LazyLoader {
        active: GlobalStates.sessionOpen

        PanelWindow {
            id: win
            screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === GlobalStates.activeScreen) ?? null
            anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
            WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:session"       // layerrule = blur, quickshell:session

            readonly property var actions: [
                { key: "l", icon: "lock",               label: "Lock",      confirm: false, run: () => GlobalStates.locked = true },
                { key: "e", icon: "logout",             label: "Log out",   confirm: true,  run: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["loginctl", "terminate-user", Quickshell.env("USER")]) },
                { key: "s", icon: "bedtime",            label: "Suspend",   confirm: false, run: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["systemctl", "suspend"]) },
                { key: "h", icon: "downloading",        label: "Hibernate", confirm: true,  run: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["systemctl", "hibernate"]) },
                { key: "r", icon: "restart_alt",        label: "Reboot",    confirm: true,  run: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["systemctl", "reboot"]) },
                { key: "p", icon: "power_settings_new", label: "Shut down", confirm: true,  run: () => Quickshell.execDetached(["systemctl", "poweroff"]) }
            ]
            property int current: 0
            property int confirming: -1                 // index awaiting confirmation

            function trigger(i: int): void {
                const a = actions[i]
                if (a.confirm && confirming !== i) { confirming = i; current = i; return }
                GlobalStates.sessionOpen = false
                a.run()
            }

            // dim background, click to close
            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                color: Colors.alpha("#000000", 0.55)
                opacity: 0
                Component.onCompleted: opacity = 1
                Behavior on opacity { Anim {} }
                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: GlobalStates.sessionOpen = false }
            }

            ColumnLayout {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                spacing: 28

                StyledText {
                    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                    text: win.confirming >= 0 ? `Press again to ${win.actions[win.confirming].label.toLowerCase()}`
                                              : "Goodbye, " + Quickshell.env("USER")
                    color: "white"
                    font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.title
                }

                RowLayout {
                    id: buttons
                    Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                    spacing: 18
                    focus: true

                    Keys.onEscapePressed: win.confirming >= 0 ? win.confirming = -1 : GlobalStates.sessionOpen = false
                    Keys.onLeftPressed: { win.current = (win.current + win.actions.length - 1) % win.actions.length; win.confirming = -1 }
                    Keys.onRightPressed: { win.current = (win.current + 1) % win.actions.length; win.confirming = -1 }
                    Keys.onReturnPressed: win.trigger(win.current)
                    Keys.onPressed: e => {
                        const i = win.actions.findIndex(a => a.key === e.text.toLowerCase())
                        if (i >= 0) { win.trigger(i); e.accepted = true }
                    }

                    Repeater {
                        model: win.actions
                        ColumnLayout {
                            id: btn
                            required property var modelData
                            required property int index
                            readonly property bool selected: win.current === index
                            readonly property bool danger: win.confirming === index
                            spacing: 10

                            // staggered entrance
                            opacity: 0
                            transform: Translate { id: tr; y: 30 }
                            Component.onCompleted: enter.start()
                            SequentialAnimation {
                                id: enter
                                PauseAnimation { duration: btn.index * 40 }
                                ParallelAnimation {
                                    NumberAnimation { target: btn; property: "opacity"; to: 1; duration: 250 }
                                    NumberAnimation { target: tr; property: "y"; to: 0; duration: 350; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic }
                                }
                            }

                            Rectangle {
                                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                                implicitWidth: 104; implicitHeight: 104
                                radius: btn.selected ? Appearance.rounding.large : 52
                                color: btn.danger ? Colors.error : btn.selected ? Colors.primary : Colors.surfaceContainerHigh
                                scale: btn.selected ? 1.06 : 1
                                Behavior on radius { Anim {} }
                                Behavior on color { CAnim {} }
                                Behavior on scale { NumberAnimation { duration: 250; easing.type: Easing.OutBack } }

                                MaterialIcon {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    icon: btn.modelData.icon
                                    size: 40
                                    fill: btn.selected ? 1 : 0
                                    color: btn.danger ? Colors.onError : btn.selected ? Colors.onPrimary : Colors.onSurface
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    hoverEnabled: true
                                    cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                    onEntered: if (win.confirming !== btn.index) { win.current = btn.index; win.confirming = -1 }
                                    onClicked: win.trigger(btn.index)
                                }
                            }
                            StyledText {
                                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                                text: btn.modelData.label
                                color: "white"
                            }
                            StyledText {
                                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                                text: btn.modelData.key.toUpperCase()
                                color: "#99ffffff"
                                font.family: Appearance.font.mono
                                font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Lock Screen

A real, secure lock screen using the Wayland ext-session-lock protocol through WlSessionLock, with PAM authentication via PamContext: a blurred wallpaper, big clock, avatar, password field with error shake, caps-lock warning, fingerprint support, and media controls.

Develop safely

A lock screen can lock you out. While developing: 1. Keep the auto-unlock safety timer in the code below until you trust your screen. 2. Know your escape hatch: switch to a TTY (Ctrl+Alt+F3), log in, run pkill -f "qs -c myshell". With ext-session-lock the compositor keeps the session locked (it shows a solid color) until a new locker takes over; on Hyprland run hyprctl --instance 0 'keyword misc:allow_session_lock_restore 1' then restart your shell, or use hyprlock as a fallback. 3. Never set locked = false anywhere except after a successful PAM result.

How session lock works#

  • While WlSessionLock.locked is true, the compositor shows only your lock surfaces and sends input only to them. No other window, no keybinds.
  • A WlSessionLockSurface is created automatically for every screen from the surface component.
  • WlSessionLock.secure becomes true once the compositor confirms every screen is covered.
  • If Quickshell crashes while locked, the session stays locked (that's the security guarantee).

The lock controller#

modules/lock/Lock.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Services.Pam
import QtQuick
import qs.services

Scope {
    id: root

    // shared state for all screens' surfaces
    property string password: ""
    property bool busy: false
    property string error: ""
    property string pamMessage: ""
    property int failures: 0

    IpcHandler { target: "lock"; function lock(): void { GlobalStates.locked = true } }

    function submit(): void {
        if (busy || password === "") return
        error = ""
        busy = true
        pam.start()
    }

    PamContext {
        id: pam
        config: "login"                     // see "fingerprint" below for a custom config
        onPamMessage: {
            if (responseRequired) {
                respond(root.password)
            } else {
                root.pamMessage = message      // e.g. "Place your finger on the sensor"
            }
        }
        onCompleted: result => {
            root.busy = false
            root.password = ""
            if (result === PamResult.Success) {
                root.failures = 0
                root.error = ""
                GlobalStates.locked = false
            } else {
                root.failures++
                root.error = result === PamResult.MaxTries ? "Too many attempts" : "Incorrect password"
            }
        }
        onError: err => { root.busy = false; root.error = "Authentication error: " + PamError.toString(err) }
    }

    WlSessionLock {
        id: lock
        locked: GlobalStates.locked
        surface: Component { LockSurface { lockScope: root } }
    }

    // ⚠ SAFETY NET while developing: unlock after 60 s. DELETE THIS when you trust it.
    Timer { running: GlobalStates.locked; interval: 60000; onTriggered: GlobalStates.locked = false }
}

The per-screen surface#

modules/lock/LockSurface.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import QtQuick.Effects
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

WlSessionLockSurface {
    id: surface
    required property var lockScope
    color: "black"

    // background: blurred, dimmed wallpaper
    Image {
        id: wall
        anchors.fill: parent
        source: "file://" + Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.cache/myshell/wallpaper"
        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
        sourceSize: Qt.size(surface.width / 2, surface.height / 2)   // blurred anyway: decode small
        asynchronous: true
        visible: false
    }
    MultiEffect {
        anchors.fill: wall
        source: wall
        blurEnabled: true; blur: 1.0; blurMax: 64
        brightness: -0.3
        opacity: wall.status === Image.Ready ? 1 : 0
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: 400 } }
    }

    // everything fades/slides in
    Item {
        anchors.fill: parent
        opacity: 0
        Component.onCompleted: opacity = 1
        Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: 400 } }

        ColumnLayout {
            anchors.centerIn: parent
            anchors.verticalCenterOffset: -40
            spacing: 6

            StyledText {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: Qt.formatDateTime(Time.now, "hh:mm")
                color: "white"
                font.pixelSize: 120
                font.weight: Font.Black
                font.features: ({ "tnum": 1 })
            }
            StyledText {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: Qt.formatDateTime(Time.now, "dddd, d MMMM")
                color: "#ddffffff"
                font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.title
            }

            Item { implicitHeight: 40 }

            ClippingRectangle {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                implicitWidth: 96; implicitHeight: 96; radius: 48
                color: Colors.primaryContainer
                Image {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    source: "file://" + Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/.face"
                    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                    sourceSize: Qt.size(192, 192)
                }
            }
            StyledText {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                text: Quickshell.env("USER")
                color: "white"
                font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.large
            }

            // password field
            Rectangle {
                id: field
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                Layout.topMargin: 12
                implicitWidth: 320
                implicitHeight: 52
                radius: 26
                color: Qt.rgba(1, 1, 1, 0.12)
                border.width: 2
                border.color: surface.lockScope.error ? Colors.error
                            : input.activeFocus ? Colors.primary : "transparent"
                Behavior on border.color { CAnim {} }

                TextInput {
                    id: input
                    anchors { fill: parent; leftMargin: 24; rightMargin: 52 }
                    verticalAlignment: TextInput.AlignVCenter
                    horizontalAlignment: TextInput.AlignHCenter
                    echoMode: TextInput.Password
                    passwordCharacter: "●"
                    color: "white"
                    font.pixelSize: 20
                    focus: true
                    enabled: !surface.lockScope.busy
                    text: surface.lockScope.password
                    onTextChanged: {
                        surface.lockScope.password = text            // shared across screens
                        if (text !== "") surface.lockScope.error = ""
                    }
                    Keys.onReturnPressed: surface.lockScope.submit()
                    Keys.onEnterPressed: surface.lockScope.submit()
                    Keys.onEscapePressed: surface.lockScope.password = ""
                    Keys.onPressed: e => capsHint.check(e)

                    StyledText {
                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                        visible: !parent.text
                        text: surface.lockScope.busy ? "Checking…" : "Enter password"
                        color: "#99ffffff"
                    }
                }
                MaterialIcon {                                       // submit / spinner
                    anchors { right: parent.right; rightMargin: 16; verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter }
                    icon: surface.lockScope.busy ? "progress_activity" : "arrow_forward"
                    color: "white"
                    RotationAnimation on rotation {
                        running: surface.lockScope.busy; from: 0; to: 360; duration: 900; loops: Animation.Infinite
                        onStopped: parent.rotation = 0
                    }
                    TapHandler { onTapped: surface.lockScope.submit() }
                }

                // error shake
                transform: Translate { id: shakeTr }
                SequentialAnimation {
                    id: shake
                    loops: 2
                    NumberAnimation { target: shakeTr; property: "x"; to: -10; duration: 40 }
                    NumberAnimation { target: shakeTr; property: "x"; to: 10; duration: 80 }
                    NumberAnimation { target: shakeTr; property: "x"; to: 0; duration: 40 }
                }
                Connections {
                    target: surface.lockScope
                    function onErrorChanged() { if (surface.lockScope.error) shake.restart() }
                }
            }

            StyledText {
                id: capsHint
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                property bool caps: false
                function check(e) { caps = e.text !== "" && e.text !== e.text.toLowerCase() && !(e.modifiers & Qt.ShiftModifier) }
                visible: caps
                text: "Caps Lock is on"
                color: Colors.tertiary
            }
            StyledText {
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
                visible: text !== ""
                text: surface.lockScope.error || surface.lockScope.pamMessage
                color: surface.lockScope.error ? Colors.error : "#ddffffff"
            }
        }

        // bottom bar: battery + media
        RowLayout {
            anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottomMargin: 32 }
            spacing: 20
            RowLayout {
                visible: Battery.available
                MaterialIcon { icon: Battery.icon; rotation: 90; color: "white" }
                StyledText { text: Math.round(Battery.percent * 100) + "%"; color: "white" }
            }
            RowLayout {
                visible: Media.active !== null
                spacing: 6
                IconButton { icon: "skip_previous"; onClicked: Media.active.previous() }
                IconButton { icon: Media.active?.isPlaying ? "pause" : "play_arrow"; onClicked: Media.active.togglePlaying() }
                IconButton { icon: "skip_next"; onClicked: Media.active.next() }
                StyledText { text: Media.active?.trackTitle ?? ""; color: "white"; Layout.maximumWidth: 260 }
            }
        }
    }
}
Caps-lock detection

Qt doesn't expose the caps-lock state directly; the heuristic above checks typed letters. For an exact indicator read /sys/class/leds/*capslock/brightness with FileView.

Fingerprint (fprintd)#

Create a PAM config that accepts fingerprint or password, and point PamContext at it:

~/.config/quickshell/myshell/pam/fprint-or-passwordauth sufficient pam_fprintd.so
auth required pam_unix.so
PamContext {
    configDirectory: Quickshell.shellPath("pam")
    config: "fprint-or-password"
}

Start an attempt as soon as the screen locks (onLockedChanged: if (locked) pam.start()) so the fingerprint reader is armed; pamMessage shows "Place your finger…".

Locking: idle, lid, sleep#

// lock after 5 min idle (see Chapter 46)
IdleMonitor { timeout: 300; respectInhibitors: true; onIsIdleChanged: if (isIdle) GlobalStates.locked = true }
hypridle.conf (if you prefer hypridle)general {
    lock_cmd = qs -c myshell ipc call lock lock
    before_sleep_cmd = qs -c myshell ipc call lock lock
}
Exercises
  1. Remove the safety timer only after testing wrong passwords, correct passwords and multiple monitors.
  2. Show the number of unread notifications on the lock screen (but not their content).
  3. Add a "Sleep" button that runs systemctl suspend.
Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Workspace Overview

An end-4-style overview: a grid of workspaces, each showing live thumbnails of its windows at their real positions and sizes. Click a window to focus it, click a workspace to switch, drag a window to another workspace to move it, type to filter by title.

This project is Hyprland-specific because it needs window geometry (HyprlandToplevel.lastIpcObject) and live capture (ScreencopyView).

How it works#

  1. On open, call Hyprland.refreshToplevels() so every window's lastIpcObject has fresh at (position) and size.
  2. Scale the monitor down (e.g. 0.16) to make a workspace cell.
  3. For each window on a workspace, place a ScreencopyView at (x − monitor.x) × scale, (y − monitor.y) × scale with width × scale, height × scale.
  4. Drag uses Qt's Drag/DropArea; drop dispatches movetoworkspacesilent.
modules/overview/Overview.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    IpcHandler { target: "overview"; function toggle(): void { GlobalStates.toggle("overview") } }

    LazyLoader {
        active: GlobalStates.overviewOpen

        PanelWindow {
            id: win
            readonly property HyprlandMonitor mon: Hyprland.focusedMonitor
            screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === mon?.name) ?? null
            anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
            WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:overview"

            readonly property int columns: 5
            readonly property int rows: 2
            readonly property real scale: 0.16
            readonly property real monW: (mon?.width ?? 1920) / (mon?.scale ?? 1)
            readonly property real monH: (mon?.height ?? 1080) / (mon?.scale ?? 1)
            readonly property real cellW: monW * scale
            readonly property real cellH: monH * scale
            property string filter: ""

            Component.onCompleted: { Hyprland.refreshToplevels(); Hyprland.refreshMonitors() }
            Connections {
                target: Hyprland
                function onRawEvent(e) {
                    if (["openwindow", "closewindow", "movewindow", "movewindowv2", "changefloatingmode"].includes(e.name))
                        Hyprland.refreshToplevels()
                }
            }

            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                color: Colors.alpha("#000000", 0.45)
                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: GlobalStates.overviewOpen = false }
            }

            Item {
                focus: true
                Keys.onEscapePressed: GlobalStates.overviewOpen = false
                Keys.onPressed: e => {
                    if (e.key === Qt.Key_Backspace) win.filter = win.filter.slice(0, -1)
                    else if (e.text.length === 1 && e.text >= " ") win.filter += e.text
                }
            }

            StyledRect {
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                width: grid.implicitWidth + 32
                height: grid.implicitHeight + 32 + (win.filter ? 40 : 0)
                level: 3
                color: Colors.surface

                StyledText {
                    visible: win.filter !== ""
                    anchors { top: parent.top; topMargin: 14; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter }
                    text: "Filter: " + win.filter
                    color: Colors.primary
                }

                GridLayout {
                    id: grid
                    anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottomMargin: 16 }
                    columns: win.columns
                    rowSpacing: 10; columnSpacing: 10

                    Repeater {
                        model: win.columns * win.rows

                        Rectangle {
                            id: wsCell
                            required property int index
                            readonly property int wsId: index + 1
                            readonly property HyprlandWorkspace ws: Hyprland.workspaces.values.find(w => w.id === wsId) ?? null
                            readonly property bool isActive: win.mon?.activeWorkspace?.id === wsId

                            implicitWidth: win.cellW
                            implicitHeight: win.cellH
                            radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
                            color: drop.containsDrag ? Colors.primaryContainer : Colors.surfaceContainer
                            border.width: isActive ? 2 : 0
                            border.color: Colors.primary
                            clip: true

                            StyledText {
                                anchors.centerIn: parent
                                text: wsCell.wsId
                                font.pixelSize: 32
                                opacity: 0.2
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: { Hyprland.dispatch("workspace " + wsCell.wsId); GlobalStates.overviewOpen = false }
                            }
                            DropArea {
                                id: drop
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                keys: ["window"]
                                onDropped: d => Hyprland.dispatch(`movetoworkspacesilent ${wsCell.wsId},address:0x${d.source.address}`)
                            }

                            Repeater {
                                model: wsCell.ws?.toplevels ?? []

                                Item {
                                    id: winItem
                                    required property HyprlandToplevel modelData
                                    readonly property var ipc: modelData.lastIpcObject
                                    readonly property string address: modelData.address
                                    readonly property bool matches: win.filter === ""
                                        || (modelData.title + " " + (ipc?.class ?? "")).toLowerCase().includes(win.filter.toLowerCase())

                                    function homeX() { return ((ipc?.at?.[0] ?? 0) - (win.mon?.x ?? 0)) * win.scale }
                                    function homeY() { return ((ipc?.at?.[1] ?? 0) - (win.mon?.y ?? 0)) * win.scale }
                                    x: homeX(); y: homeY()
                                    width: Math.max(10, (ipc?.size?.[0] ?? 100) * win.scale)
                                    height: Math.max(10, (ipc?.size?.[1] ?? 100) * win.scale)
                                    opacity: matches ? 1 : 0.25
                                    z: dragArea.drag.active ? 10 : (ipc?.floating ? 2 : 1)

                                    Drag.active: dragArea.drag.active
                                    Drag.source: winItem
                                    Drag.keys: ["window"]
                                    Drag.hotSpot: Qt.point(width / 2, height / 2)

                                    ClippingRectangle {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        radius: 6
                                        color: Colors.surfaceContainerHighest
                                        border.width: hov.hovered ? 2 : 0
                                        border.color: Colors.primary

                                        ScreencopyView {
                                            anchors.fill: parent
                                            captureSource: winItem.modelData.wayland
                                            live: true
                                            constraintSize: Qt.size(width, height)
                                        }
                                        IconImage {
                                            anchors { right: parent.right; bottom: parent.bottom; margins: 3 }
                                            implicitSize: Math.min(24, parent.height / 2)
                                            source: Quickshell.iconPath(DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(winItem.ipc?.class ?? "")?.icon ?? "", "application-x-executable")
                                        }
                                    }
                                    HoverHandler { id: hov }
                                    MouseArea {
                                        id: dragArea
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        drag.target: parent
                                        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.MiddleButton
                                        onClicked: m => {
                                            if (m.button === Qt.MiddleButton) Hyprland.dispatch("closewindow address:0x" + winItem.address)
                                            else { Hyprland.dispatch("focuswindow address:0x" + winItem.address); GlobalStates.overviewOpen = false }
                                        }
                                        onReleased: {
                                            parent.Drag.drop()
                                            parent.x = Qt.binding(() => winItem.homeX())   // snap back (the move happens via IPC)
                                            parent.y = Qt.binding(() => winItem.homeY())
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
Address format

HyprlandToplevel.address is the hex address without 0x; dispatchers want address:0x….

Performance#

Ten workspaces with many live previews can cost GPU time. Options:

  • live: false and call captureFrame() once when opening (still images).
  • Only make previews live for the hovered workspace.
  • Lower win.scale.

Keybind#

hyprland.confbind  = SUPER, Tab, global, quickshell:overview
# or open on releasing Super alone, like end-4:
bindr = SUPER, SUPER_L, global, quickshell:overview
Exercises
  1. Arrow keys to move a selection between windows, Enter to focus.
  2. Add a search box that also lists matching apps (combine with the launcher).
  3. Show special workspaces (negative ids) in an extra row.
Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Dock

A macOS-style dock that works on any compositor: pinned apps plus running apps, running indicators, focus or cycle windows on click, middle-click for a new instance, right-click menu with actions, magnification on hover, and auto-hide that reveals when the mouse touches the bottom edge.

Pinned apps in config#

// in services/Config.qml JsonAdapter
property JsonObject dock: JsonObject {
    property bool enabled: true
    property bool autoHide: true
    property list<string> pinned: ["firefox", "kitty", "org.gnome.Nautilus", "spotify", "code"]
}

The dock#

modules/dock/Dock.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Widgets
import QtQuick
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    Variants {
        model: Config.dock.enabled ? Quickshell.screens : []

        PanelWindow {
            id: dock
            required property ShellScreen modelData
            screen: modelData

            anchors.bottom: true
            implicitWidth: Math.max(200, row.implicitWidth + 40)
            implicitHeight: 96                       // tall enough for magnified icons
            exclusionMode: Config.dock.autoHide ? ExclusionMode.Ignore : ExclusionMode.Auto
            exclusiveZone: Config.dock.autoHide ? 0 : 72
            color: "transparent"
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:dock"

            // all windows on this screen
            readonly property var windows: ToplevelManager.toplevels.values.filter(t => t.screens.includes(modelData))
            // pinned first, then running apps not pinned
            readonly property var apps: {
                const ids = [...Config.dock.pinned]
                for (const w of windows) {
                    const id = w.appId
                    if (id && !ids.some(p => p.toLowerCase() === id.toLowerCase())) ids.push(id)
                }
                return ids
            }

            readonly property bool revealed: !Config.dock.autoHide || hover.hovered || menu.visible
                                             || (ToplevelManager.activeToplevel === null)        // show on empty desktop

            // when hidden, only a 3 px strip at the bottom catches the mouse
            mask: Region { item: dock.revealed ? body : trigger }
            Item { id: trigger; anchors.bottom: parent.bottom; width: parent.width; height: 3 }
            HoverHandler { id: hover }

            StyledRect {
                id: body
                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                width: row.implicitWidth + 20
                height: 64
                y: dock.revealed ? parent.height - height - 8 : parent.height + 4
                Behavior on y { Anim {} }
                level: 2
                radius: Appearance.rounding.large
                color: Colors.barBackground

                Row {
                    id: row
                    anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; bottomMargin: 8; horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter }
                    spacing: 6

                    Repeater {
                        model: ScriptModel { values: dock.apps }

                        Item {
                            id: app
                            required property string modelData
                            readonly property DesktopEntry entry: DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup(modelData)
                            readonly property var appWindows: dock.windows.filter(w => w.appId.toLowerCase() === modelData.toLowerCase()
                                                                          || w.appId.toLowerCase() === (entry?.startupClass ?? "").toLowerCase())
                            readonly property bool focused: appWindows.some(w => w.activated)
                            readonly property real mag: iconHover.hovered ? 1.35 : 1

                            width: 48 * mag
                            height: 48
                            Behavior on width { Anim { duration: Appearance.anim.fast } }

                            IconImage {
                                id: icon
                                anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; bottom: parent.bottom }
                                implicitSize: 44 * app.mag
                                Behavior on implicitSize { Anim { duration: Appearance.anim.fast } }
                                source: Quickshell.iconPath(app.entry?.icon ?? app.modelData, "application-x-executable")
                                asynchronous: true
                            }

                            // running indicators (one dot per window, max 3)
                            Row {
                                anchors { horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; top: parent.bottom; topMargin: 2 }
                                spacing: 3
                                Repeater {
                                    model: Math.min(3, app.appWindows.length)
                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: app.focused ? 12 : 5; height: 4; radius: 2
                                        color: app.focused ? Colors.primary : Colors.onSurfaceVariant
                                        Behavior on width { Anim {} }
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            Tooltip { target: app; text: app.entry?.name ?? app.modelData; show: iconHover.hovered && !menu.visible }
                            HoverHandler { id: iconHover }

                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.MiddleButton | Qt.RightButton
                                cursorShape: Qt.PointingHandCursor
                                onClicked: m => {
                                    if (m.button === Qt.RightButton) { menu.app = app; menu.visible = true; return }
                                    if (m.button === Qt.MiddleButton || app.appWindows.length === 0) {
                                        if (app.entry) Apps.launch(app.entry)
                                        return
                                    }
                                    // cycle through this app's windows; minimize if it's the only focused one
                                    const i = app.appWindows.findIndex(w => w.activated)
                                    if (i >= 0 && app.appWindows.length === 1) app.appWindows[0].minimized = true
                                    else app.appWindows[(i + 1) % app.appWindows.length].activate()
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            DockMenu { id: menu; dockWindow: dock }
        }
    }
}

Right-click menu#

modules/dock/DockMenu.qmlimport Quickshell
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import qs.services
import qs.widgets
import qs.modules.bar          // MenuRow from the tray chapter

PopupWindow {
    id: root
    required property var dockWindow
    property Item app: null
    readonly property bool pinned: app ? Config.dock.pinned.includes(app.modelData) : false

    anchor.item: app ?? dockWindow.contentItem
    anchor.edges: Edges.Top
    anchor.gravity: Edges.Top
    anchor.margins.bottom: 8
    implicitWidth: 220
    implicitHeight: col.implicitHeight + 12
    color: "transparent"
    visible: false
    grabFocus: true

    StyledRect {
        anchors.fill: parent
        level: 2
        radius: Appearance.rounding.normal
        ColumnLayout {
            id: col
            anchors { left: parent.left; right: parent.right; top: parent.top; margins: 6 }
            spacing: 2

            StyledText { text: root.app?.entry?.name ?? ""; font.bold: true; Layout.margins: 8 }

            Repeater {                                    // desktop actions
                model: root.app?.entry?.actions ?? []
                MenuRow { required property DesktopAction modelData; label: modelData.name
                          onActivated: { modelData.execute(); root.visible = false } }
            }
            MenuRow {
                label: "New window"; leadingIcon: "add"
                onActivated: { Apps.launch(root.app.entry); root.visible = false }
            }
            MenuRow {
                label: root.pinned ? "Unpin" : "Pin to dock"
                leadingIcon: root.pinned ? "keep_off" : "keep"
                onActivated: {
                    const id = root.app.modelData
                    Config.dock.pinned = root.pinned ? Config.dock.pinned.filter(p => p !== id) : [...Config.dock.pinned, id]
                    root.visible = false
                }
            }
            MenuRow {
                visible: (root.app?.appWindows.length ?? 0) > 0
                label: "Close all"; leadingIcon: "close"
                onActivated: { root.app.appWindows.forEach(w => w.close()); root.visible = false }
            }
        }
    }
}

Matching windows to apps#

App ids aren't always the desktop file name: Firefox reports firefox, Nautilus org.gnome.Nautilus, Chromium apps chrome-<id>-Default, Electron apps sometimes their own names. DesktopEntries.heuristicLookup() handles most cases; DesktopEntry.startupClass (the StartupWMClass key) covers many others.

Minimize animations#

Tell the compositor where a window's dock icon is, so minimize animations fly to it:

Component.onCompleted: app.appWindows.forEach(w => w.setRectangle(dock, dock.itemRect(icon)))
Exercises
  1. Add drag-to-reorder for pinned apps (save the order to Config).
  2. Add a separator between pinned and running-only apps.
  3. Hide the dock while any window on this screen is fullscreen (windows.some(w => w.fullscreen)).
Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Wallpaper and Theme Switcher

Two pieces: a wallpaper layer drawn by Quickshell (so you don't need swww/hyprpaper) with crossfade transitions, and a picker that shows thumbnails of your wallpaper folder; choosing one changes the wallpaper and re-themes the whole shell through matugen (Colors and Wallpaper Theming).

Wallpaper service#

services/Wallpaper.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root
    readonly property string dir: Config.wallpaper?.dir ?? (Quickshell.env("HOME") + "/Pictures/Wallpapers")
    property string current: state.path
    property var files: []

    function set(path: string): void {
        state.path = path
        Quickshell.execDetached([Quickshell.shellPath("scripts/wallpaper.sh"), path, Config.appearance.mode ?? "dark"])
    }
    function random(): void { if (files.length) set(files[Math.floor(Math.random() * files.length)]) }
    function rescan(): void { scan.running = true }

    Process {
        id: scan
        running: true
        command: ["find", root.dir, "-maxdepth", "2", "-type", "f",
                  "(", "-iname", "*.jpg", "-o", "-iname", "*.jpeg", "-o", "-iname", "*.png", "-o", "-iname", "*.webp", ")"]
        stdout: StdioCollector { onStreamFinished: root.files = text.trim().split("\n").filter(f => f).sort() }
    }

    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.statePath("wallpaper.json")
        onAdapterUpdated: writeAdapter()
        printErrors: false
        JsonAdapter { id: state; property string path: "" }
    }

    IpcHandler {
        target: "wallpaper"
        function set(path: string): void { root.set(path) }
        function random(): void { root.random() }
        function picker(): void { GlobalStates.toggle("wallpaperPicker") }
        function get(): string { return root.current }
    }
}

The background layer with crossfade#

modules/wallpaper/Wallpaper.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import QtQuick
import qs.services

Scope {
    Variants {
        model: Quickshell.screens

        PanelWindow {
            id: bg
            required property ShellScreen modelData
            screen: modelData
            anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "black"
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Background
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:wallpaper"

            // two images: the new one fades in over the old one
            property bool showA: true
            property string target: Wallpaper.current ? "file://" + Wallpaper.current : ""
            onTargetChanged: {
                const next = showA ? imgB : imgA
                next.source = target
            }

            component Wall: Image {
                anchors.fill: parent
                fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                sourceSize: Qt.size(bg.width * bg.modelData.devicePixelRatio, bg.height * bg.modelData.devicePixelRatio)
                asynchronous: true
                cache: false
                smooth: true
                Behavior on opacity { NumberAnimation { duration: 800; easing.type: Easing.InOutQuad } }
            }

            Wall {
                id: imgA
                opacity: bg.showA ? 1 : 0
                onStatusChanged: if (status === Image.Ready && source == bg.target) bg.showA = true
            }
            Wall {
                id: imgB
                opacity: bg.showA ? 0 : 1
                onStatusChanged: if (status === Image.Ready && source == bg.target) bg.showA = false
            }
            Component.onCompleted: imgA.source = target
        }
    }
}

The new image loads in the hidden layer; when it's ready, showA flips and the opacity Behaviors crossfade.

Thumbnail cache (large folders)#

Decoding many 4K images is slow even with sourceSize. Pre-generate thumbnails once with ImageMagick and show those:

scripts/thumbs.sh#!/usr/bin/env bash
src="$1"; out="$HOME/.cache/myshell/thumbs"; mkdir -p "$out"
for f in "$src"/*.{jpg,jpeg,png,webp}; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  t="$out/$(echo -n "$f" | md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1).jpg"
  [ -e "$t" ] || magick "$f" -resize 560x360^ -gravity center -extent 560x360 -quality 85 "$t"
done

Video and animated wallpapers#

import QtMultimedia
Video {
    anchors.fill: parent
    source: "file:///home/me/Videos/live.mp4"
    loops: MediaPlayer.Infinite
    autoPlay: true
    muted: true
    fillMode: VideoOutput.PreserveAspectCrop
}

Video decoding costs power; pause it when a window covers the screen (ToplevelManager.toplevels.values.some(t => t.fullscreen || t.maximized)).

Part VI · Build-Along Projects

Project: Clipboard Manager

A searchable clipboard history with image previews, built on cliphist: open it with a key, type to filter, press Enter to copy an entry back, Delete to remove it, and pin favorites.

Setup#

sudo pacman -S cliphist wl-clipboard
hyprland.confexec-once = wl-paste --type text  --watch cliphist store
exec-once = wl-paste --type image --watch cliphist store
bind = SUPER, V, exec, qs -c myshell ipc call clipboard toggle

cliphist list prints ID<TAB>preview lines, newest first; cliphist decode ID outputs the original content; cliphist delete removes an entry (it reads the ID<TAB>… line from stdin).

The service#

services/Clipboard.qmlpragma Singleton
import Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick

Singleton {
    id: root
    property var entries: []                     // [{ id, text, isImage }]
    property var pinned: pins.items              // list of ids

    function refresh(): void { listProc.running = true }

    function copy(e): void {
        Quickshell.execDetached(["sh", "-c", 'cliphist decode "$1" | wl-copy', "sh", e.id])
    }
    function remove(e): void {
        delProc.command = ["sh", "-c", 'printf "%s\\t%s" "$1" "$2" | cliphist delete', "sh", e.id, e.text]
        delProc.running = true
    }
    function wipe(): void { Quickshell.execDetached(["cliphist", "wipe"]); entries = [] }
    function togglePin(e): void {
        pins.items = pins.items.includes(e.id) ? pins.items.filter(i => i !== e.id) : [...pins.items, e.id]
    }

    Process {
        id: listProc
        command: ["cliphist", "list"]
        stdout: StdioCollector {
            onStreamFinished: root.entries = text.split("\n").filter(l => l).map(l => {
                const tab = l.indexOf("\t")
                const t = l.slice(tab + 1)
                return { id: l.slice(0, tab), text: t, isImage: t.startsWith("[[ binary data") }
            })
        }
    }
    Process { id: delProc; onExited: root.refresh() }

    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.statePath("clipboard-pins.json")
        onAdapterUpdated: writeAdapter()
        printErrors: false
        JsonAdapter { id: pins; property list<string> items: [] }
    }
}

Image previews#

cliphist stores images too. Decode one to a temporary file to preview it:

modules/clipboard/ImagePreview.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import QtQuick

Image {
    id: root
    required property string entryId
    readonly property string tmp: Quickshell.cachePath("clip-" + entryId + ".png")
    fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectFit
    asynchronous: true
    cache: false

    Process {
        running: true
        command: ["sh", "-c", 'mkdir -p "$(dirname "$2")"; [ -f "$2" ] || cliphist decode "$1" > "$2"', "sh", root.entryId, root.tmp]
        onExited: root.source = "file://" + root.tmp
    }
}

The window#

modules/clipboard/ClipboardWindow.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import Quickshell.Hyprland
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Layouts
import QtQuick.Controls
import qs.services
import qs.widgets

Scope {
    IpcHandler { target: "clipboard"; function toggle(): void { GlobalStates.toggle("clipboard") } }

    LazyLoader {
        active: GlobalStates.clipboardOpen

        PanelWindow {
            id: win
            screen: Quickshell.screens.find(s => s.name === GlobalStates.activeScreen) ?? null
            implicitWidth: 560
            implicitHeight: 600
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
            WlrLayershell.keyboardFocus: WlrKeyboardFocus.Exclusive
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:clipboard"
            HyprlandFocusGrab { windows: [win]; active: true; onCleared: GlobalStates.clipboardOpen = false }

            Component.onCompleted: Clipboard.refresh()

            readonly property var filtered: {
                const q = search.text.toLowerCase()
                const items = Clipboard.entries.filter(e => !q || e.text.toLowerCase().includes(q))
                return [...items.filter(e => Clipboard.pinned.includes(e.id)), ...items.filter(e => !Clipboard.pinned.includes(e.id))]
            }

            function pick(): void {
                const e = filtered[list.currentIndex]
                if (e) Clipboard.copy(e)
                GlobalStates.clipboardOpen = false
            }

            StyledRect {
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.margins: 8
                level: 3
                color: Colors.surface

                ColumnLayout {
                    anchors { fill: parent; margins: 14 }
                    spacing: 10

                    RowLayout {
                        TextField {
                            id: search
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            placeholderText: "Search clipboard…"
                            focus: true
                            onTextChanged: list.currentIndex = 0
                            Keys.onEscapePressed: GlobalStates.clipboardOpen = false
                            Keys.onReturnPressed: win.pick()
                            Keys.onDownPressed: list.incrementCurrentIndex()
                            Keys.onUpPressed: list.decrementCurrentIndex()
                            Keys.onDeletePressed: { const e = win.filtered[list.currentIndex]; if (e) Clipboard.remove(e) }
                            Keys.onPressed: ev => {
                                if (ev.key === Qt.Key_P && ev.modifiers & Qt.ControlModifier) {
                                    const e = win.filtered[list.currentIndex]; if (e) Clipboard.togglePin(e)
                                    ev.accepted = true
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        IconButton { icon: "delete_sweep"; onClicked: Clipboard.wipe() }
                    }

                    ListView {
                        id: list
                        Layout.fillWidth: true
                        Layout.fillHeight: true
                        clip: true
                        spacing: 4
                        model: ScriptModel { values: win.filtered; objectProp: "id" }
                        highlight: Rectangle { radius: Appearance.rounding.normal; color: Colors.secondaryContainer }
                        highlightMoveDuration: 100

                        delegate: Item {
                            id: row
                            required property var modelData
                            required property int index
                            width: ListView.view.width
                            implicitHeight: modelData.isImage ? 120 : Math.min(76, txt.implicitHeight + 20)

                            RowLayout {
                                anchors { fill: parent; margins: 10 }
                                spacing: 10
                                MaterialIcon {
                                    visible: Clipboard.pinned.includes(row.modelData.id)
                                    icon: "keep"; size: 16; color: Colors.primary
                                }
                                ImagePreview {
                                    visible: row.modelData.isImage
                                    entryId: row.modelData.id
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    Layout.fillHeight: true
                                    horizontalAlignment: Image.AlignLeft
                                }
                                StyledText {
                                    id: txt
                                    visible: !row.modelData.isImage
                                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                                    text: row.modelData.text
                                    wrapMode: Text.WrapAnywhere
                                    maximumLineCount: 3
                                    textFormat: Text.PlainText              // never interpret clipboard as markup
                                    font.family: Appearance.font.mono
                                    font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
                                }
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                hoverEnabled: true
                                acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton | Qt.RightButton
                                onEntered: list.currentIndex = row.index
                                onClicked: m => m.button === Qt.RightButton ? Clipboard.togglePin(row.modelData) : win.pick()
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    StyledText {
                        text: "Enter copy · Del remove · Ctrl+P pin · Esc close"
                        color: Colors.outline
                        font.pixelSize: Appearance.font.size.small
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
Privacy

Clipboard history stores passwords you copy. Many password managers set a "sensitive" hint; cliphist can be told to skip some content (wl-paste --watch cliphist -max-items 200 store). Consider a wipe keybind and don't show the history on the lock screen.

Project: Desktop Widgets and Screen Corners

Decorations that make a rice feel finished: rounded screen corners, a desktop clock on the Bottom layer, a system monitor widget with rings and a graph, a weather card, and draggable widgets that remember their position.

Rounded screen corners#

modules/decorations/ScreenCorners.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Wayland
import QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes
import qs.services

Scope {
    component Corner: Shape {
        id: c
        property int r: Config.appearance.screenRounding ?? 18
        property int rot: 0                  // 0 TL, 90 TR, 180 BR, 270 BL
        width: r; height: r
        rotation: rot
        preferredRendererType: Shape.CurveRenderer
        ShapePath {
            fillColor: "black"
            strokeWidth: -1
            startX: 0; startY: 0
            PathLine { x: c.r; y: 0 }
            PathArc { x: 0; y: c.r; radiusX: c.r; radiusY: c.r; direction: PathArc.Counterclockwise }
            PathLine { x: 0; y: 0 }
        }
    }

    Variants {
        model: Quickshell.screens
        PanelWindow {
            required property ShellScreen modelData
            screen: modelData
            anchors { top: true; bottom: true; left: true; right: true }
            exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
            color: "transparent"
            mask: Region {}                                    // never blocks input
            WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Overlay
            WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:corners"

            Corner { anchors { top: parent.top; left: parent.left } rot: 0 }
            Corner { anchors { top: parent.top; right: parent.right } rot: 90 }
            Corner { anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; right: parent.right } rot: 180 }
            Corner { anchors { bottom: parent.bottom; left: parent.left } rot: 270 }
        }
    }
}
Corners under the bar

If the bar is attached to the top edge, draw the top corners below the bar (offset by the bar height) and color them like the bar for the "bar melts into the screen" look end-4 uses.

A desktop widget base with dragging and saved position#

widgets/DesktopWidget.qmlimport Quickshell
import Quickshell.Io
import Quickshell.Wayland
import QtQuick
import qs.services

PanelWindow {
    id: root
    required property string widgetId
    default property alias content: body.data
    property int defaultX: 80
    property int defaultY: 80

    anchors { top: true; left: true }
    margins { left: pos.x; top: pos.y }
    implicitWidth: body.childrenRect.width
    implicitHeight: body.childrenRect.height
    exclusionMode: ExclusionMode.Ignore
    color: "transparent"
    WlrLayershell.layer: WlrLayer.Bottom                       // above wallpaper, below windows
    WlrLayershell.namespace: "quickshell:desktop-" + widgetId

    Item { id: body; anchors.fill: parent }

    // drag with Super held to reposition; saved per widget
    MouseArea {
        anchors.fill: parent
        property point start
        acceptedButtons: Qt.LeftButton
        onPressed: m => { if (!(m.modifiers & Qt.MetaModifier)) { m.accepted = false; return } start = Qt.point(m.x, m.y) }
        onPositionChanged: m => {
            if (!pressed) return
            pos.x = Math.max(0, pos.x + m.x - start.x)
            pos.y = Math.max(0, pos.y + m.y - start.y)
        }
    }

    FileView {
        path: Quickshell.statePath("desktop-" + root.widgetId + ".json")
        onAdapterUpdated: writeAdapter()
        printErrors: false
        JsonAdapter { id: pos; property int x: root.defaultX; property int y: root.defaultY }
    }
}

System monitor widget#

Reuses the SystemUsage service from Running Commands with Process and the ring from Shapes and Canvas:

widgets/Ring.qmlimport QtQuick
import QtQuick.Shapes
import qs.services

Item {
    id: root
    property real value: 0
    property string label: ""
    property color color: Colors.primary
    property real thickness: 7
    implicitWidth: 90; implicitHeight: 90

    Shape {
        anchors.fill: parent
        preferredRendererType: Shape.CurveRenderer
        ShapePath {
            fillColor: "transparent"; strokeColor: Colors.surfaceContainerHighest
            strokeWidth: root.thickness; capStyle: ShapePath.RoundCap
            PathAngleArc { centerX: root.width / 2; centerY: root.height / 2
                           radiusX: root.width / 2 - root.thickness; radiusY: radiusX; startAngle: 0; sweepAngle: 360 }
        }
        ShapePath {
            fillColor: "transparent"; strokeColor: root.color
            strokeWidth: root.thickness; capStyle: ShapePath.RoundCap
            PathAngleArc { centerX: root.width / 2; centerY: root.height / 2
                           radiusX: root.width / 2 - root.thickness; radiusY: radiusX
                           startAngle: -90; sweepAngle: 360 * Math.min(1, root.value) }
        }
    }
    Column {
        anchors.centerIn: parent
        StyledText { anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; text: Math.round(root.value * 100) + "%"; font.bold: true; font.pixelSize: 18 }
        StyledText { anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter; text: root.label; color: Colors.onSurfaceVariant; font.pixelSize: 11 }
    }
    Behavior on value { NumberAnimation { duration: 600; easing.type: Easing.OutCubic } }
}
